title: Do LLMs Follow Their Own Rules? A Reflexive Audit of Self-Stated Safety Policies

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing a model's self-stated safety policies against its actual refusal behavior using explicitly harmful benchmark prompts (from SORRY-Bench) categorized under discrimination and stereotypes.
Evaluating behavioral compliance by testing whether an LLM consistently refuses prompts requesting hate speech according to the safety rules it articulates.
